title: Desmos Calculator Mastery
intro: The Digital SAT gives you a built-in Desmos graphing calculator on every Math question, and using it well can turn minutes of algebra into a few clicks. This is a hands-on guide. Every technique below is shown on Vidaara’s own graphing calculator — the same one in the dock at the top-right of this page — and most lessons embed a live calculator so you can try it as you read.

items.name: Solve f(x)=0
items.formula: graph y=f(x); turn on key points

items.name: Solve an equation
items.formula: graph both sides; read where they meet
